project: Graph-Guided Repository Navigation for Coding Agents
method_note: This script implements a separate keyword-overlap baseline and an import-neighbor score boost. It does not call the existing baseline_search.py or graph_search.py implementations.
validity_warning: Queries were selected from repository source descriptions, so lexical overlap may be inflated. Results are exploratory and do not establish generalization or superiority.

metrics.runtime_note: Single-process prototype measurements; not a reliable benchmark of speed.
